assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope
The symptoms are not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring
A cardiac event monitoring study is indicated for extended rhythm assessment
The diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is coded I48.0
The diagnosis of syncope is coded R55
The cardiac event monitoring study is coded CPT 93271
The payer denied the claim under Reason Code CO-97
The denial asserts that payment for the service is bundled into another covered procedure
Separate reimbursement is not permitted under current policy guidelines
The patient has the right to file an appeal
Appeals must be submitted in writing within the timeframe specified in the plan documents
